statement: FPA revenue monotonicity proof uses convexity of f(p)=max_i(t_i p_i) + Jensen over a mean-preserving spread induced by refinement (Theorem 5.1, Section 5).
method: (a) random Jensen checks on f; (b) per-cluster verification of mean-preserving spread (calibration) and the Jensen inequality sum_j lambda_j f(p_sub_j) >= f(p_coarse).

nonconvex_f.description: Replace f by non-convex min; Jensen must fail.

broken_mps.description: Break calibration so sub predictions don't average to coarse; Jensen inequality must fail.
